description: Permanently deletes a customer and cancels active subscriptions. Use when you need to remove a customer record from your Stripe account. This operation is irreversible and automatically terminates any active subscriptions.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a customer.

customer.description: The identifier of the customer to be deleted. Must be a valid Stripe customer ID starting with 'cus_'.
customer.title: Customer

inputSchema.title: DeleteCustomersCustomerRequest

name: delete_customers_customer

DeleteCustomersCustomerResponse.description: Response model for a deleted customer.

deleted.description: Confirmation flag, always true for successful deletion.
deleted.title: Deleted

id.description: The unique identifier of the deleted customer.
id.title: Id

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'customer' for this endpoint.
object.title: Object
